question: Which of these is NOT a part of the MS Office Suite?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Projects**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Projects** is not a part of the MS Office Suite.
 
• MS Office Suite typically includes applications like **Word**, **Excel**, and **PowerPoint**, among others.
 
• Each application within the suite serves a specific purpose: **Word** for word processing, **Excel** for spreadsheets, and **PowerPoint** for presentations.
 
• The MS Office Suite is widely used for both personal and professional tasks due to its comprehensive set of features and tools.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Microsoft Office** was first announced by Bill Gates on August 1, 1988.
 
• The suite has evolved significantly over the years, with numerous versions and updates to improve functionality and user experience.
 
• Other popular applications in the suite include **Outlook** for email, **Access** for database management, and **OneNote** for note-taking.
 
• Microsoft also offers a cloud-based version of the suite called **Office 365**, which provides additional features and online storage.
 
• Office 365 is now known as **Microsoft 365** and includes advanced security and compliance capabilities.
